rationale: The plan matches the reference closely: no refit of the count model, ORA via clusterProfiler::enrichGO on GO BP with the tested-gene universe, a 15-500 size window, BH at 0.05, rrvgo redundancy collapse, up/down lists tested separately with the pooled run labelled secondary, and GSEA confined to an explicitly secondary check when the list is too short. QC is design-specific (blind VST, PCA, distance heatmap, library sizes) with a stated keep-inspect-report policy for sample_01, and the contrast, reference level and sign convention are made explicit before directional claims. Weaknesses are minor: no low-count filter is stated even for the QC transform, size-factor normalization is only implied through VST rather than stated, and fold-change shrinkage of the delivered log2FC is not addressed (direction is split at zero, which is an implicit rather than stated no-FC-cutoff choice). The report specification is complete, covering versions, universe size, list sizes, unmapped share, caveats and a reproducibility record.
